news.title: Sorry about that long-ish outage, but we were YET AGAIN getting smashed by AI bots. I have…
news.author: xrobau@mastodon.au
news.snippet: Sorry about that long-ish outage, but we were YET AGAIN getting smashed by AI bots. I have given up fighting them, and I'm just scaling up until # mastodonAU can handle the load. This time the # PostgreSQL database was running at a load of 100+ because it was disk IO bound. I did *try* to live migrate it, but it was just insanely slow so I made the call to shut it down (hence the 'Something went wrong' errors) and move it offline. It's moved. Now it's running on a pure SSD-only backing store, which hopefully will handle everything the # AI scrapers throw at us. I'll be doing the same thing with # MastodonNZ too, shortly (but hopefully without the outage, as that's a much more lightweight instance) I also really need to fix the status page that comes up when mau is down.
